question: What divine nature is attributed to the brahmin in this teaching?
premises: The brahmin is described as consisting of all gods.
The brahmin is of the nature of Brahmā, Viṣṇu, and Śiva.
Both descriptions identify the brahmin with divine totality.
inference: The brahmin is presented as embodying the totality of the gods.
plain_english: The brahmin consists of all gods and is of the nature of Brahmā, Viṣṇu, and Śiva.
